description: With Twitter, you can watch the world unfold like never before. ** Get real-time stories, pictures, videos, conversations, ideas, and inspiration all in your timeline. ** Follow people and your interests to get unfiltered access and unique behind-the-scenes perspectives. ** Express yourself with photos, videos and comments. Twitter for Windows 8 brings you all the design, features and functionality of Twitter combined with the fast and fluid technology of Windows 8.
